description: This Python script updates a sidebar markdown document by inserting or replacing a list of links to API documentation files located in the '../../docs/apis' directory. It reads the existing sidebar, identifies the section for API links, and updates it with the current list of markdown files, formatting plugin names specially.

methods.name: update_sidebar()
methods.description: Main function that updates the sidebar.md file with current list of API markdown files from the specified directory.
